description: Whether the app's PRE sells through Stripe's TEST mode: on by default, so testers buy with Stripe's test cards and nothing is charged. Pre always sells the app's own products (one catalogue); in test mode it also lists the ones not published yet. Test purchases are marked as such: pro never counts them, not even when pre plays with pro's data (neblla_pre_data), and there they give no credits. Without "on", returns the current value. Also says "testMode" ("separate": the developer needs a test account of their own, opened at onboardingUrl with Stripe's test data; "same": this server is in test mode and the payout account serves; "off": no test mode here, so pre test purchases fail) and "account" (the state of that account). Turning it off makes pre charge real money on the payout account: only when the developer asked for it.

on.description: Set it; omit to read it

name: neblla_pre_stripe_test
